$comment: MCP server specification for EAB 4.6.0 (chip-generation CLI: bt82x / bt81x / bt88x / ft81x / ft80x). The engine (src/script) reads ONLY this file - server identity, skills, tools, messages, outputs and the inline catalog.commands. The legacy EAB <= 4.5 spec lives in EAB_mcp_data.json; the server picks the matching spec automatically from the detected eab_tools.exe flavour, or explicitly via EAB_MCP_SPEC / --spec.

server.name: EAB MCP server
server.description: MCP server for Bridgetek Eve Asset Builder (EAB Tools) 4.6.0. Exposes typed per-command tools, a natural-language assistant, and a mandatory confirmation flow before executing eab_tools.exe.
server.instructions:
You are connected to the Bridgetek Eve Asset Builder (EAB) MCP server for EAB 4.6.0, which drives eab_tools.exe to convert, compress, validate and program EVE graphics assets (images, fonts, audio, video, GIF animations, raw pixel buffers, SPI flash images).

CHIP TOKENS (EAB 4.6 CLI):
- The CLI selects a chip generation with a token before the command: bt82x (BT820), bt81x (BT815/6/7/8), bt88x (BT880/1/2/3), ft81x (FT810/1/2/3), ft80x (FT800/1).
- Typed tools expose this as the `chip_gen` option. bt81x, bt88x, ft81x and ft80x share one command family, so the same options apply to all four.
- Commands shared by every chip (compress, bin2c, font_info) take no chip token.

MANDATORY ROUTING RULE:
- Whenever the user request mentions "eab", "EVE", "Bridgetek", "eab_tools", "EVE Asset Builder", or involves EVE / FT8xx graphics asset work (conversion, compression, flash programming, validation, font/image/audio/video/animation), you MUST call the `eab` tool first. It is the primary assistant that finds the correct command and next step.
- Do not guess a command or invoke an eab_* tool directly until `eab` has pointed you to the right command.
- For multi-step jobs follow the workflow prompts (eab-workflow-*) and read the eab://workflows resource.

EXECUTION RULE:
- Asset-changing tools (eab_*) never run directly. They return a preview + requestId. Get the user to approve, then call execute_eab_tool_call with confirm=true. Use update_eab_tool_call to adjust options before running.
- Read eab://catalog to see every command, eab://skills to see available skills, eab://prompts for reusable templates, and this message for guidance.

INSTALL / UPDATE RULE:
- If eab_tools.exe cannot be found, or the user asks to install or update EAB, call check_eab_installation first.
- Then offer to download EAB from https://github.com/Bridgetek/EAB-CLI with install_eab_cli. It returns a plan; call it again with confirm=true only after the user approves.
- The downloaded package is unpacked into %LOCALAPPDATA%\EAB-CLI and is picked up automatically by eab_tools.exe discovery.

VERSION HANDLING:
- The server follows the eab_tools.exe you select. Passing EAB_TOOL_PATH for a build of another EAB version switches the loaded spec automatically; no restart is needed.
- When several eab_tools.exe builds are installed, the response lists `candidates` (path, version, flavor, managed). Ask the user which one to use, then pass it as EAB_TOOL_PATH.
- EAB 4.6+ uses chip tokens bt82x / bt81x / bt88x / ft81x / ft80x; EAB <= 4.5 uses 82x / pre82x. Never mix tokens from the other version.
- If a response contains cliVersionWarning, the spec could not be switched (explicit EAB_MCP_SPEC/--spec). Tell the user which spec to load.

skills.name: EAB engineering assistant
skills.description: Answer natural-language questions about EAB tools and commands.

skills.name: EAB tool routing
skills.description: Route any request mentioning eab / EVE / Bridgetek or EVE asset work to the `eab` tool first.

skills.name: workflow guidance
skills.description: Multi-step EAB workflows: asset conversion pipeline, flash programming pipeline, validation pipeline. See eab://workflows and the eab-workflow-* prompts.

skills.name: asset conversion
skills.description: Convert images, fonts, audio, video, animations and raw pixel buffers.

skills.name: compression
skills.description: Compress / decompress assets with zlib or zopfli.

skills.name: flash management
skills.description: Build flash images and program / verify SPI flash over USB.

skills.name: validation and inspection
skills.description: Validate images, inspect fonts, view raw buffers and disassemble display lists.

skills.name: code generation
skills.description: Generate C arrays and sample applications for FT4222 / MPSSE.

typedTools.descriptionNote: Execution always requires confirmation: this tool returns a preview + requestId, then run execute_eab_tool_call with confirm=true after the user approves. Use update_eab_tool_call to adjust the options first if needed.

tools.name: list_eab_catalog
tools.description: List all commands loaded from the catalog, including their target chip and options.

tools.name: prepare_eab_tool_call
tools.description: Validate the tool path, load a command preview, and create a confirmation request.

EAB_TOOL_PATH.description: Absolute path to the CLI executable (e.g. eab_tools.exe).

commandName.description: Command name from the catalog. Chip-prefixed names like "82x img_cvt" are accepted.

targetChip.description: Optional target chip filter, such as BT82X or Pre-BT82X.

cliArgs.description: Raw CLI arguments to pass after the command name.

chipGen.description: Chip token for the CLI: bt82x, bt81x, bt88x, ft81x or ft80x. Defaults to the command's own token.

tools.name: update_eab_tool_call
tools.description: Modify the options of a pending request (add, change, or remove) before execution. Show the updated preview to the user, then run execute_eab_tool_call with confirm=true after approval.

requestId.description: Request id returned by prepare_eab_tool_call or any typed eab_* tool.

options.description: Options to set or overwrite (snake_case keys). Pass null, "" or false to remove a key.

remove.description: Option keys to remove from the pending command.

cliArgs.description: For raw prepare requests: replace the raw CLI arguments entirely.

tools.name: execute_eab_tool_call
tools.description: Final gate: run a previously prepared command only after the user has approved the exact options. Returns awaiting_confirmation when confirm is false so the options can still be reviewed or edited.

requestId.description: Request id returned by prepare_eab_tool_call or any typed eab_* tool.

EAB_TOOL_PATH.description: Optional override path to the CLI executable.

confirm.description: Must be true to allow execution.

tools.name: ask_eab
tools.description: Primary assistant. Ask in natural language what tool or command to use for a task (convert image, build font, compress assets, program flash, disassemble, etc.). Returns matched commands with scores, required flags, examples and a suggested next step.

tools.name: eab
tools.description: MANDATORY routing assistant (alias of ask_eab). You MUST call this tool FIRST for any request that mentions "eab", "EVE", "Bridgetek", "eab_tools", "EVE Asset Builder", or involves EVE / FT8xx asset work (convert, compress, program, validate images/fonts/audio/video/animation/flash). Ask in natural language what tool or command to use; returns matched commands with scores, required flags, examples and a suggested next step.

tools.name: eab_sample
tools.description: Request the MCP client to generate a message through its LLM (sampling/createMessage). Useful to ask the model for a recommended EAB command or a conversion plan. Requires the connected client to support sampling.

query.description: The question to ask the model, e.g. "Which EAB command converts a PNG to RGB565 for BT82X?".

tools.name: list_eab_workflows
tools.description: List all built-in EAB multi-step workflows (conversion pipeline, flash programming pipeline, validation pipeline, ...) with their ordered steps and required tools.

tools.name: list_eab_skills
tools.description: List the full skill definitions (Skill Definition integration) exposed by this server, including the EAB tool routing rule, with the skills also available as eab://skills/<slug> resources.

tools.name: explain_eab_command
tools.description: Explain a single command: its description, chip generation, every option (flag, type, default, required) and an example invocation.

command.description: Command name, e.g. img_cvt, font, audio, flash_prog, bin2c.

targetChip.description: Optional chip token (bt82x / bt81x / bt88x / ft81x / ft80x) or target chip (BT82X / Pre-BT82X).

tools.name: find_relevant_eab_tool
tools.description: Given a natural-language task, recommend the most relevant command(s) with a reason and an example invocation.

task.description: Description of the asset conversion / validation task.

tools.name: suggest_eab_command
tools.description: Convert a natural-language request into a concrete command suggestion with the recommended MCP tool and the exact invocation to run.

request.description: Natural-language task, e.g. "Convert this PNG to RGB565".

targetChip.description: Optional chip preference: BT82X or Pre-BT82X.

tools.name: check_eab_installation
tools.description: Check whether EAB (eab_tools.exe) is installed on this PC, which version is present, and whether a newer build is available in the Bridgetek/EAB-CLI repository. Call this first when eab_tools.exe cannot be found or the user asks about installing/updating EAB.

installDir.description: Optional install directory to inspect. Defaults to %LOCALAPPDATA%\EAB-CLI (override with EAB_CLI_INSTALL_DIR).

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit of Bridgetek/EAB-CLI to compare against. Defaults to main.

token.description: Optional GitHub token for the private Bridgetek/EAB-CLI repository. Defaults to EAB_GITHUB_TOKEN / GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN, then `gh auth token`.

checkRemote.description: Set false to skip the GitHub lookup and only report the local installation.

tools.name: install_eab_cli
tools.description: Download and install (or update) EAB from the Bridgetek/EAB-CLI repository (https://github.com/Bridgetek/EAB-CLI) when eab_tools.exe is missing or outdated. Without confirm=true it only returns the install plan; call it again with confirm=true after the user approves.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually download and install. Omit to get the plan only.

force.description: Reinstall even when the installed build already matches the latest commit.

installDir.description: Target install directory. Defaults to %LOCALAPPDATA%\EAB-CLI (override with EAB_CLI_INSTALL_DIR).

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit of Bridgetek/EAB-CLI to install. Defaults to main.

token.description: Optional GitHub token for the private Bridgetek/EAB-CLI repository. Defaults to EAB_GITHUB_TOKEN / GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN, then `gh auth token`.
